Question 14
?

If n2 is odd, then n is odd.

Express the statement above in formal language, given that n is a natural number.

a
∀n∈N, (n2 is odd) ⇒ (n is odd)
b
∀n∈N, (n2 is odd) ∧ (n is odd)
c
∃n∈N, (n2 is odd) ∧ (n is odd)
d
∃n∈N, (n2 is odd) ⇒ (n is odd)
e
∀n∈N, (n2 is odd) ⇔ (n is odd)
